answer: At first light a claimant stands on a canyon floor carved by a river and flashes a coded beacon light across the canyon wall, photographed with a timestamp and a witness beside the canyon log. Two canyon keepers verify the photograph against the beacon registry and the canyon log within five days. A copied photograph, a wrong canyon, or a missing log entry voids the season, burns a 60-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for a year. One honest claimant spends 60 credits; a thousand fakes would need a thousand canyon descents and a thousand beacon flashes.
